column1: # Alex waits in the Altin Peak west exit after Mercury Lighthouse is lit.

column3: Isaac, you've walked so\nmany roads for a man who\nhates where they all lead.{end_wait}
Alex? Where were you when\nVale drowned? What do you\nwant from me?{end_wait}
Not every friend you keep\nis really a friend. Count\nyour party twice, Isaac.{end_wait}
The rain will tell you the\nrest. It always does in the\nend.{end_wait}
